required_runtime_ownership.required: Positive stopped/reset states after FSBL, cache/coherency ownership; catch stop is not proof.
Verified held-reset/idle policy and no PMU release during test.
Audit linked firmware callbacks/DDR accesses; cannot treat running MicroBlaze as absent.
Per-channel enable/state and ownership proof. XSA USE=0 does not establish physical reset/quiescence.
Completion/drain state and exclusive owner; no ISR-clear substitutes.
Inventory enabled blocks; runtime/reset/traffic ownership before destructive writes.
Bind active bitstream to source; prevent new requests AND prove outstanding reads drained, not just enable=0.

limits: Selected static XSA only, not current live configuration, active bitstream binding, disabled hardware, bus drain or writable DDR ownership.
